messages.author: ccb659debca44e10
messages.subject: groupComparison adj.pvalue
parts:
Hello all,
I am trying to understand if the groupProcess() function by default uses the Benjamini-Hochberg method when calculating its adj.pvalue (qvalue). I read in the following pdf file on page 21 that it does: https://msstats.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/MSstats_v3.7.3_manual.pdf
however when I use the following code to check:
test_BH$adj.pvalue = p.adjust(test_BH$pvalue,method="BH",
                              length(test_BH$pvalue))
I get different adj.pvalue outputs.

messages.author: bc13a282f8b0c08b
messages.subject: Re: groupComparison adj.pvalue
parts:
Hi,


BH correction is applied within each comparison separately



Kind regards
Mateusz
